title: Weekly content plan
ask: Plan the content for the seven days starting today: three short posts and one newsletter, each one planned for a particular day in those seven days. Draw only on the company's own documents and on what the company did last week, and do not invent facts. Write each piece as a draft for me to read, in the Marketer's usual draft layout with its title, channel and planned date at the top, so that it reaches my content calendar; put nothing else beside the drafts. Nothing is to be published or sent. In your report, say which facts you were missing and could not find, so that I can supply them.
